segments.text:
V. 24.
Take heed what ye hear—That is, Attend to what you hear, that it may have its due Influence upon you. With what meaſure ye mete—That is, according to the Improvement you make of what you have heard, ſtill further Aſſiſtances ſhall be given. And to you that hear—That is, with Improvement.
